title: Win AI-led discovery and checkout while memory costs squeeze PCs
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); Amazon says 400M used Alexa for Shopping and wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases. Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028; DDR5 prices doubled; Apple flagged a margin drop.

points.headline: AI assistants now start shopping journeys, and Amazon closes most of the sales
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases and widened Shop Direct to hold shoppers. We should make our listings agent-readable and contest checkout in AI journeys.

points.headline: Agent payment rails are forming with major AI platforms
points.detail: Mastercard formed OpenAI and Tencent partnerships for agentic commerce. We should confirm our store can accept agent-initiated checkout and payments.

points.headline: Memory shortage keeps PC costs and prices rising into 2028
points.detail: Samsung sees no buyer relief before 2028, DDR5 prices doubled, Asus expects commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26. We should plan pricing, promotions and inventory for sustained cost pressure.

points.headline: Apple posts record quarter but warns of holiday margin drop from memory costs
points.detail: Apple reported $114.5B September-quarter revenue on iPhone and Mac strength, raised prices, and forecast lower holiday-quarter margin. We should expect competitor price moves to reset PC expectations.
